question: Can parameter-free positive registered portal-plane extent overlap provide absolute support for rank-only surface correspondence under same-class missing and extra candidates?

predecessor.observed_gap: The raw witness ceiling removed two rank-only false matches but rejected sixteen true matches because stable same-class door surfaces had widely different cross-rescan residuals.

method_sources.name: OMNet: Learning Overlapping Mask for Partial-to-Partial Point Cloud Registration
method_sources.used_idea: Model whether geometric regions overlap rather than treating a global distance threshold as correspondence existence.

method_sources.name: Overlap-Guided Gaussian Mixture Models for Point Cloud Registration
method_sources.used_idea: Use overlap support to handle partial scans and density variation; this experiment uses a deterministic registered-extent analogue rather than a learned model.

frozen_cohort.selection_order: Exclude every physical reference target in the ten consumed cohorts. Group the frozen candidate rows by scan family and normalized semantic class in first-occurrence order. Choose the first family/class with six distinct surfaces on both scans and take its first six rows in the existing area-proxy order before computing surface scores or extent overlap.
frozen_cohort.scenario_contract: Use one closed-six scenario, one query-extra scenario, one reference-extra scenario, and all thirty ordered balanced missing-plus-extra swaps across the six same-class targets.
forbidden: using surface distances or extent overlaps to select the family, class, targets, or swaps
setting a positive IoU magnitude threshold after replay
dropping any balanced swap after observing outcomes
reusing any consumed physical reference target
using target IDs inside evaluated correspondence ranking or support

frozen_model.pair_score: The unchanged negative symmetric median nearest-surface distance after the official rigid transform.
frozen_model.rank_only_baseline: Strict reciprocal row-and-column maxima on the pair score.
frozen_model.absolute_support: For each reference candidate, fit the existing deterministic upright portal frame, project its surface and each transformed query surface into horizontal-by-vertical coordinates, take convex hulls, and require strictly positive intersection area. No IoU magnitude threshold is used.
frozen_model.zero_assignment: Keep a rank-only reciprocal edge only when absolute support is positive; otherwise leave the relevant node unmatched.
frozen_model.complete_baseline: Complete Hungarian assignment on the unchanged pair score.

decision_gate.rank_only_incremental_opportunity: Rank-only must emit at least one false positive across the frozen scenarios.
decision_gate.support_true_matches: All frozen truth correspondences across all scenarios.
decision_gate.zero_assignment: Exact unmatched reference and query sets in every frozen scenario.
decision_gate.no_true_match_regression: Extent-supported true positives must be at least rank-only true positives.
decision_gate.single_replay: One replay on the frozen physical-target-disjoint same-class cohort; do not tune or rerun after outcome.

claim_boundary: A pass is same-provider, same-scan-family, physical-target-disjoint real-geometry Development evidence that parameter-free positive registered planar extent overlap adds decision-changing absolute support over rank-only surface matching for truth-proposed stable indoor doorframes under bounded missing/extra rosters. Provider labels, complete surfaces, and the rigid transform are privileged. Positive projected overlap is spatial support, not portal ownership, public access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, provider-independent confirmation, user benefit, or mobility safety.
